correctness.rationale: The source RESULT at blob d6e381458664bf89bf354662dbff52a7834ec927 identifies graphical-zonotope vertices with acyclic orientations and edges with one-edge reversible changes; a vertex is simple iff degree n-1. An independent Python implementation enumerated all 25 unordered multipartite types with 3<=n<=7, generated all orientations from topological total orders, computed reversible-edge induced components, and found only (3,3,1): (1902 vertices,860 simple, [430,430]) and (3,2,2): (2286,1240,[1192]+48 singletons); K222 has (426,288,[288]). This is genuine exhaustive finite proof only through n=7.
